goal: Allow wallet users to set an independent maximum fee rate limit via a new -maxfeerate startup option
Separate absolute fee limits from feerate limits across transaction creation, fee bumping, and broadcast
agreement: Strong support with all substantive objections resolved
Enables independently constraining total transaction fee and feerate (murchandamus)
Fixed sendall feerate checks to properly account for unconfirmed input bump fees (polespinasa)
Restricted option scope to wallet and preserved relay fee sanity checks (glozow, josibake)

categories.name: rpc
why: P3 because it separates fee and feerate constraints in broadcast RPC error reporting
Callers receive distinct error messages indicating exactly which limit was exceeded

categories.name: wallet
why: P2 because it resolves conflation between absolute fee caps and feerate limits in wallet settings
Gives wallet users precise protection against high fee rates without capping total transaction weight
